The Google Health API is closed to new projects (facts/fitbit-google.yaml), so a self-hosting team without its own Google Health project may have no route at all; the radar-base.org Google User Data Privacy Policy suggests KCL holds one for its own deployment. The Hyve's managed service still advertises Fitbit training.
